name: 一日一冊の読書チャレンジ
prompt:
Create a faithful Japanese learning component on a 390 × 680 px portrait canvas. Use the native preview for exact type, content, geometry and crop. Use the original Headway screenshot for source wording, media and challenge-progress state. Use references 3–5 as protected source images: place each image unchanged; do not redraw, repaint, recolor, crop differently or add overlays to the book covers or trophy artwork. Return the component canvas only, with no phone frame, system bar or app chrome.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep every interface surface pure white #FFFFFF: page, day cards, book-card backing, trophy backing and action area. Remove the pale mint fill from the secondary “読む” action. Separate controls with fine neutral #E4E4E4 outlines and a thin neutral timeline. No cream, mint, blush or other pale tinted surfaces; no gradients, tinted shadows, glow or decorative texture. Preserve original colors only inside the supplied book-cover and trophy media. Use the Lighthouse forest green #047857 as a solid accent for challenge text, completed/current markers and the primary “聞く” action. Keep readable near-black text #1D1D1D and neutral gray supporting copy #6E6E6E.

Match native geometry:
- Title x=16/y=8, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28: “朝の読書習慣”.
- Subtitle x=16/y=48, 358×24, Meiryo Bold 14/24, forest green: “5日間のチャレンジ”.
- Thin horizontal timeline x=16/y=160, 374×1, neutral #E4E4E4.
- Day 1 card x=16/y=134, 146×44, white, rounded 8 px, thin neutral border; green check at x=26/y=150, 14×12; text at x=44/y=146, Meiryo Bold 14/24: “1日目”. This day is complete.
- Day 2 card x=266/y=134, 146×44, white with a clear solid forest-green outline to show the current day; show an empty green outlined square at x=276/y=150, 14×12, and text at x=294/y=146, Meiryo Bold 14/24: “2日目”. This day is active, not completed, matching the original screenshot’s empty marker. The card and content continue beyond the 390 px viewport and are clipped at the right edge as in the native layout.
- First exact supplied book cover at x=16/y=196, 170×258. Second exact supplied book cover at x=266/y=196, 170×258, clipped by the right viewport edge. Preserve each original image’s pixel artwork and rounded crop.
- Trophy section heading x=16/y=502, 248×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28: “達成のトロフィー”. Supporting copy x=232/y=504, 142×32, Meiryo Regular 12/16, neutral gray: “読み進めて獲得しましょう” (two short lines).
- Exact supplied trophy artwork x=16/y=548, 358×58, unchanged.
- Secondary “読む” action x=16/y=624, 110×44, white with a thin neutral outline and near-black Meiryo Regular 14/24 text.
- Primary “聞く” action x=136/y=624, 238×44, flat solid forest green #047857 with white Meiryo Regular 14/24 text.

Preserve all Japanese wording, the two book covers, three trophy graphics, Day 1 complete and Day 2 active state. The native preview currently shows a checkmark on Day 2, but the source screenshot shows Day 2 active with an empty square; follow the source state. Keep the screen compact, legible and uncluttered. Do not add labels, icons, artwork, badges or controls beyond the listed content.
reviewNotes: Pure-white interface surfaces and no pale UI tints verified. Day 1 complete, Day 2 active. Modest subtitle/action vertical drift remains for one correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
